description:
Remove the decision-kind copies from the projection-render harness tests.

## Background

`fast_rules/project_render_harness_tests.rs` (`:133`, `:189`, `:467`) restates the decision kind and its `D-[0-9]+` id pattern. Shared test support derives the shipped item kinds from `profiles/jit-default/manifest.toml`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Tests in these files that need a shipped kind take it from the shared derivation of the default package.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test that needs a kind the package does not ship declares a minimal literal, and its name or comment says the kind is custom.
- [hard] REQ-03: No test in these files restates a shipped kind's declaration or its id pattern.
title: Projection-render tests take shipped item kinds from the default package
